description: Inspire the troops to gain Training

events.name: Standing Armies

outcomes.label: Rally Standing Armies Repair Four Improvements
Rally Standing Armies Repair Eight Improvements

options.text: They will join laborers in the procurement of materials.
We need more troops to enforce the peace.
Cities need more defensive fortifications.

events.text: Inspired by your speeches, soldiers across [rival] intensify their drills and combat training. When they are not honing their military prowess, they dedicate their time and energies to improving the Cities in which they live. Thousands of fighting men and women take to the streets to volunteer their time. Officers have appealed to the court for direction. How shall soldiers focus their labors?

events.name: The Most Trusted
events.text: The troops march in lockstep. The thud of boots on earth and the glint of armor catching the setting sun creates an almighty spectacle. [character] has been keen to show you a display of the forces that he has helped to shape and lead. Your heart swells with ambition, right before it is pierced by [character] dagger. The army stands at attention. Watching, unmoving, already loyal to the new King.

events.name: Angry Soldiers

options.text: I need to try again. The soldiers must trust me.
There is no more time for these speeches.

events.text: The military crowds in [city] seem rowdier than usual. As you deliver your rousing oration, stones begin to fly, followed by insults. A scuffle breaks out. A soldier with a dagger rushes towards you... but he is killed before he can raise his weapon. Guards hurry you from the scene, but the incident leaves a lasting impression. Your ties with the military have worn worryingly thin.

events.name: Blood for Blood

options.text: They want blood, they will have it.

events.text: Attempts to embolden our army prove highly successful. Unfortunately, some soldiers grow too frenzied for their own good. Inflamed by the fires of war (and wine), several units carouse until the early morning hours before stalking into a nearby [tribe] encampment and slaughtering a group of innocent women and children. The [tribe] seek blood for blood, assembling their war parties.

events.name: Hollow Rhetoric

options.text: I will not stand for such insubordination.
It is an officer's duty to question his orders.

requirements.label: Warrior / Brave / Valiant
tip: The leader must have one of: Warrior (a cognomen — an earned leader title); Brave (a cognomen — an earned leader title); Valiant (a cognomen — an earned leader title)

options.text: [character] must be reminded of my military experience.

events.text: Your series of inspiring speeches fall on deaf ears, as the soldiers of the [rival] army turn their backs on you at every stop. On your last visit to a military training ground, General [character] confronts you. You have heard that he is beloved by troops across the nation. "Hollow rhetoric means nothing to the fighting man," he says, as his soldiers look on. "You would be wise to remember that when the blood begins to spill."

events.name: In the Field

options.text: Sadly, I do not have the time, but good luck.
Of course, I will join you in the wilds of [rival].

events.text: When you arrive in [city] to inspire the troops, an opportunity arises. Several units of infantryman are about to embark on a wilderness expedition meant to test their survival strength, resourcefulness, and stealth. The officers in charge extend an invitation. If you have the time, they would love for you to join them in this bonding exercise and pass on your wisdom to the young recruits.

events.name: Our Allegiance

options.text: All serve Ahura Mazda in the battle against evil.
They fight for the good of [rival] and its ruler.
We are done following the whims of faith.

events.text: Murmurs of discontent can be heard in military camps across [rival]. With the rise of [religion], many of its adherents claim that they are "soldiers for Ahura Mazda". Such a bold statement unnerves the other men, who have pledged allegiance to you, [character]. For whom do our armies fight? Our [title], or our god?

events.name: Overlooked Innovators

options.text: Promote this man above his superiors.
I will take the time to listen.

events.text: Moved by your electrifying oration in [city], a small group of soldiers seeks a private audience. They wish to share several scientific developments created during their time in training. Their leader, a frail, well-spoken swordsman, explains that their group has been scoffed at by officers and ridiculed by fellow troops. No one will listen to their ideas. Will you?

events.name: Proud Throngs

options.text: We should always celebrate our brave soldiers.

events.text: In an effort to inspire your forces, you visit every city in [rival], speaking before throngs of eager soldiers. The gatherings attract proud citizens, who openly share their food and drink with the assembled crowds. The tour proves a rousing success, one with unintended benefits. Both [city] and [city] still ring with celebrations days after your departure.

events.name: The Drunken Army

options.text: I should be more careful with my wine.

events.text: You are met with cheers as you arrive at the military training grounds. Servants unload wagons of fine food and wine for the soldiers, and you toast their courage and good health. Revels continue late into the night. The next day, you discover that General [character] and his men have started training while still inebriated from the previous evening's festivities. Several of the troops sustain injuries in the resulting drills, and [character] must retire to his tent to recover.

events.name: Thrown Roses

options.text: Our forces are ready for anything.
Allow my admirers to approach and touch me.

events.text: Soldiers of [rival] admire and respect your leadership, recognizing you as one of their own. Touring the streets of [city] on horseback, flanked by your royal guard, the cheering crowds bolster your spirit. A winding column of troops twists through the dusty streets. Flowers rain down upon your head throughout the entirety of your speech. You are adored.

events.name: [religion] Mercenaries

options.text: We welcome them to fight for [rival], and for [religion].
We will not hire them.

events.text: A group of grizzled soldiers approach one of our outposts, offering their allegiance. They say that they are fighters second, and [religion] first. Out of respect for us as [religion] nation, the soldiers are willing to join us for a smaller payment than most mercenaries would request. Should we accept this offer?

name: Rally Troops

outcomes.description: You have rallied the military, resulting in higher morale and discipline.
outcomes.name: Troops Rallied

outcomes.name: Rally Troops Event

subject: Leader

events.name: Accidents Happen

options.text: Send the [family] gifts to ease their sorrow.
Remove [character] from the court.

events.text: Workers on a [family] estate recently attempted to use an early model of a windlass in building construction. Sadly, the apparatus collapsed due to its faulty design. The disaster killed three servants and injured a distant [family] cousin. Members of the family have come to court, demanding reparations, or the removal of the great scientist [character], who first suggested they use the device.

events.name: In Remembrance

options.text: It is right to honor the great [family] rulers.
No, not unless all past rulers receive this honor.
A day for all past rulers of [rival] will be established.

events.text: [character] and other members of the [family] family wish to commemorate the great [character] with a national day of recognition. Unfortunately, this proposal strikes several other influential families as potentially problematic. Elevating [character] to a revered status only strengthens his legacy in the eyes of the [rival] people.

events.name: Brutal Heir

options.text: We will compensate those who have suffered.
It is an heir's right to punish the weak.
[character] must be taught compassion.

events.text: A group of scarred and bloodied laborers come to court, accusing the royal heir, [character], of unspeakable brutalities. According to their stories, he sets impossible production quotas, punishing those who fail short with prison, beatings, and even crucifixion. The workers request our immediate intervention.

events.name: Courtly Love

options.text: The crown finds in favor of [character] of family [family].
Due to, ah, considerations of time, [character] shall see to this case and issue a ruling.

events.text: [character] presents a compelling case for... what was his case again? Why are his eyes so mesmerizing? Is it the framing of those flowing locks of hair?

events.name: War Council

options.text: You honor me, [character]! Your bodyguard will fight bravely against the [rival].
That is a noble offer, [character], but we don't require such a sacrifice at this time.

events.text: In times of war like these, the Champions of the [family] Family are eager to show their worth. When summoned with the other Family Heads to Hold Court, [character], Oligarch of the [family], offered to send his personal retinue into the fray. We would simply need to provide some funds for their upkeep. The [family] consider this a great honor, and would feel slighted if denied the opportunity to send [character]'s bodyguard to fight for you against the treacherous [rival].

events.name: Sage Counsel

options.text: Reduce the backlog of legal cases.
Train additional advocates.
Find ways to improve efficiency.

events.text: Recent policy changes have expedited legal matters across the kingdom, leaving many advocates with new-found availability. We should put these experts to task. How shall these scholars direct their efforts?

events.name: Legal Dispute

options.text: [city] is a [family] city, so a property with disputed ownership is [family].
If the judge says the [family] are rightful owners of the property, so be it.
We can find a fair and just way for both families to share the property.
So much talk, so much chaos... turn it over to the common folk of [city].

events.text: A recent court case has turned into a major dispute. The cause is a property dispute between the [family] and the [family] in [city], the [family] family seat. The case went to the city's court where the judge was also [family]. Unsurprisingly, [family] said they would not recognize a ruling by a [family] judge in a [family] city. To everyone's great surprise, the judge ruled in favor of the [family] who are looking to accept the ruling, but now the [family] are calling foul play. Both families send representatives stating that they hold you in high esteem and ask for you to decide the dispute.

events.name: Lifestyles of the Rich

options.text: Send the cheats and plotters away!
A noble trading guild is a sound idea.
They have approval, but they must fund it themselves.

events.text: In court, members of the [family] family argue bitterly with the great merchant [character]. The [family] demand the formation of a noble trading guild that would grant lower prices and exclusivity on certain goods. If their demand is not granted, they will refuse to buy from royal vendors. [character] appears shaken by the threats.

events.name: A Crowd of Admirers

options.text: I will take a moment to reflect on the glory of [rival], and my well earned respect as her leader.

events.text: You hold a successful court amidst a throng of admirers! The leading men and women of every [rival] Family come to pay homage. Entourage in tow, they all show their sincere respect for your rule. Bask in the glow of this glorious day!

events.name: Family Court Drama

options.text: I wish to make amends however I might. Please, allow me to finance the occasion.
I haven't got any time for this sniveling.

events.text: You hold court in [city], the family seat of the [family]. This leads the [family] to believe that you show them special favor, and in return they put on lavish, and expensive, banquets for the occasion. However, they feel slighted when in fact you give all families and courtiers equal recognition during the proceedings, and never even thank them for hosting your entourage. The crestfallen leader of the [family], [character], comes to you with these concerns. He feels that without some recompense, the [family] family will find it difficult to forgive such an insult.

events.name: The Fighting Class

options.text: Permit the fighting class to form an assembly.
Reevaluate our laws for better representation.
Provide the masses with a short-lived distraction.

events.text: A column of militiamen winds its way through [city] to the royal palace, interrupting a political debate. After years of living at the mercy of the court, they demand representation. These men, mostly farmers, are made to spend years away from their homes in times of war, leaving their families to ruin, and all at the whim of the ruling class. They demand a seat in court, or at the very least the ability to elect their own officials.

events.name: A Flower Out of the Dirt

options.text: Appoint [character] to the position of Minister right away. Spare no expense!
We've no place for him at this time.

events.text: Through many days of often exhausting court proceedings, you are repeatedly impressed with the intellect and charisma of [character]. He is a shining beacon of sincerity and genuine company among a throng of sycophants. His piercing insights into issues of high importance, combined with the undeniable charm of his eloquent delivery, have won over many members of the court, yourself included. Shall you make [character] an official Minister?

events.name: An Exhausting Ordeal

options.text: I am so relieved to be done with this. At least I have learned something from the ordeal.

events.text: You called all of the leading families of [rival] to Hold Court in your Capital City of [city]. The proceedings are long and tiresome and you grow ever more wearied by the ordeal. The [family] and [family] Family have taken to court gossip out of boredom, and the [family] hardly ever even show up for this tedium. However, the Family Heads ultimately appreciate the effort to include them in court ceremonies, and the experience you've gained from the occasion is invaluable. Your reputation as a legitimate ruler who cares for his realm has improved.

events.name: Family Scuffle

options.text: I will reluctantly take the side of the [family] in this dispute.
I will reluctantly take the side of the [family] in this dispute.
Come now, let us end this needless quarrel without any mutual hostilities.

events.text: The leading families of [rival] have come to Hold Court. The proceedings have have not all gone as planned though. The merriment of the occasion has evaporated as [character] of the [family] Family and [character] of the [family] Family have been quarrelsome since they arrived. One insult is always met with another, as the two escalate their game of invectives. The other guests are concerned that it may come to blows. The respective heads of these Family, [character] and [character], are firm in their resolve to take their relation's side. Each Family Head is adamant that you show them favor, and condemn the other party.

events.name: Ostracized

options.text: There is no compelling evidence against [character].
We have no choice but to cast out the villain!
Refute the charges against [character].

events.text: After several contentious encounters, the [family] family accuses the [family] of political wrongdoing, specifically [character]. They request that all citizens of [city] write the name of someone on the court whom they wish to see "ostracized." They have chosen [character]. We have not seen evidence of his crimes, but the accusers have whipped the population into a frenzy. They want blood.

events.name: Two Mothers One Child

options.text: The [family] are known for their pale hair.
I recognize the classic [family] nose.
They can each have half of the child.
The mother is the one who would rather give up the child than see it die.

events.text: Two mothers come to you with a living baby, and a dead baby. They both swear that the living child is theirs and the dead child is the other's. They ask you to settle the dispute. How will you decide who is truthful?

outcomes.description: You have held court, handing out wise judgements and important reforms.
outcomes.name: Hold Court

outcomes.description: While holding court, you have discovered a promising new Courtier.
outcomes.name: Hold Court, New Courtier

outcomes.name: Hold Court Event

description: Steal a Nation's research to gain Science

events.name: Defecting Scientists

options.text: We will provide whatever they need.

events.text: [character]'s mission to steal [rival] secrets has proven more successful than expected. Not only have our spies returned with valuable secrets, but they have also convinced several notable [rival] scientists to come with them. The court has agreed to expedite the building of a new facility where these scientists can continue their work.

events.name: Seeking Help

options.text: I wish him a speedy recovery.

events.text: Our agent in [rival] has returned triumphant, bearing caches of scientific research. Unfortunately, the stressful experience has taken its toll on [character]. He has chosen to leave the Council and seek the healing power of the temple. We will need to find a new spymaster.

events.name: Selling Secrets

options.text: You never can trust a spy.

events.text: Months have passed since [character] sent his agent into [rival] to steal its scientific secrets. Finally, news of his betrayal begin to trickle in from other sources. Instead of stealing knowledge from the [rival], our spy sold them our secrets for an astronomical sum, after which he crossed into the wilds to the east and disappeared.

events.name: Fingers

options.text: We will not give in to threats.
I refuse to have this blood on my hands.

events.text: In a series of unfortunate events, [character]'s spies in [rival] are captured and tortured for information about their mission. Every week, the court receives a new finger. [character] demands that we pay a steep price for the lives of our agents. Some of our new scientific discoveries would be a place to start.

events.name: [rival] Discovery

options.text: We can always use a fresh voice in court.
She must focus on understanding this discovery.

events.text: [character]'s spy has managed to escape from [rival] with an abundance of stolen scientific research. This trove of knowledge includes a groundbreaking discovery on which the [rival] have been working for years. This success has us wondering if this spy has potential beyond espionage.

name: Steal Research

outcomes.description: [character] has successfully stolen research from your rival.
outcomes.name: Research Stolen

outcomes.description: [character] has successfully stolen research from your rival but was exposed in the process.
outcomes.name: Research Stolen, Effort Exposed

outcomes.name: Steal Research Event

subject: Spymaster

events.name: Acidic

options.text: There is only so much one can take.

events.text: As time rolled by, you had hoped life with [character] would settle into something more comfortable, maybe even pleasant. But his cold stares, acidic tongue, and mirthless sarcasm continue to make each day an ever more taxing gauntlet.

events.name: Court of the Hunnic Kings
events.text: Your Ambassador [character] has determined that an envoy should be sent to the [tribe] in a mission to placate their warlike leaders. Although an important task, you are reminded of the rumors of the ‘less than savory’ fate of other kingdoms’ envoys to the tribe. However, [character] is sure that a significantly prestigious envoy will impress [character] and guarantee their safe return.

events.name: Fools and Madmen

options.text: Excellent, and much more entertaining than a spelling bee!

events.text: It is said that the Gods sometimes smile on fools and madmen. That certainly seems to be the case where you and [character] are concerned. The two of you share more than a touch of madness in common and can often be found shirking responsibility, drinking, howling at the moon and sometimes engaging in even more outrageous behavior. Recently, after a night spent getting more intoxicated than should have been humanly possible, you gave your own bodyguards the slip, made your way to the city streets and invented a new dance which the general public seems to quite enjoy. You've seen your citizens spontaneously break out into dance, emulating the steps you and [character] invented and everyone seems to be having a good time at it.

events.name: Influence of God's Consort

options.text: [character] is proving worthy of the title!

events.text: When [character] is brought before you, he is already receptive to your influence. He says that [character] approached him for support, and how can one refuse Gods Consort?

events.name: Planetary Influence
events.text: The astronomer [character] is happy to spend time with you, as long as you listen to his findings. The results are surprisingly informative. he has divided the night sky into segments, groups of stars that can be tracked as they move and regularly appear and disappear.

events.name: Spy vs. Spy

options.text: I have already invested too much in this mission.
Direct our agents to befriend the young Heir.
We may need to remove [character], if it comes to that.

events.text: Our agents in [rival] have found it difficult to make contact with [character], encountering strong resistance in the form of a spy network run by his heir, [character]. Any attempts to sway [character]'s opinion have failed, although [character]'s interest seems piqued by this game of intrigue. This may be an unexpected opportunity to endear ourselves to [character], the rising heir, but we would need to tread lightly.

events.name: Making Marriage Work

options.text: I love you too!

events.text: [character], my husband, I never thought I would find love in our marriage but I am glad that I have.

events.name: Quality Time

options.text: The night is young.

events.text: It is a genuine pleasure to spend time with your husband, and tonight you have time for a quiet meal together with all his favorite foods, some wine, and a delicious dessert. Afterwards, who knows what might happen?

events.name: Quality Time

options.text: The night is young.

I know I hurt you. I treated you poorly and that was wrong of me. I acted in a most unkingly manner.” He looks into your eyes for several moments, clearly thinking intently, before replying. “Very well, [character], you seem genuinely sorry and I’m willing to give you another chance. Don’t make me regret it.”

events.name: Intercessional Truce

options.text: Agree to peace.
No, that is enough.

events.text: A messenger arrives at your court from [character], praising your glory and devoutness. In front of the gathered nobles, he states that after the words of [character] on your behalf, [character] wants to unite the people of [rival] and [rival] under a peace of the [religion] faithful. There are murmurs of curiosity amongst those listening but the [family] family are quick to take the floor, decrying this attack on [rival] values and independence.

events.name: Intercessional Bond

options.text: Allow [character] to visit whenever possible.
Allow it this once.
Do not compare my child to [character]’s.

An invitation for the child, [character], to spend time at the palace would help your cause, but could be seen as beneath your station.

events.name: Intercessional Replacement

options.text: Offer [character] support in his plan.
Send a warning to [character].
[character] is too dangerous, have [character] ‘remove’ the problem.

events.text: Your Spymaster [character] took the precaution of setting an agent to track the progress of [character]’s intercession. What was discovered is a much greater plot with implications for the entire world. [character] has been using all of his support and contacts to maneuver to be able to take the position as Religion Head of [religion]. It seems that [character] has no idea and is due to meet with [character] the following week, in what is most likely a trap. This surprising information has put you in a position of power. What will you do with what you know?

events.name: Intercessional Debate

options.text: There’s always another way, pressure [character] instead.
[religion] can’t afford to lose face, buy [character]’s silence about this meeting.
He’s right, you’ve shown yourself as a fool.

events.text: [character] met with [character] as planned, with the aim of swaying him to your cause. [character] was left at a loss for words and was entirely unable to convince [character] of anything, let alone of your greatness. He returns to you in embarrassment.

events.name: Intercessional Donation

options.text: Humbly decline the offer.
Ask for him to fund a disciple.
We need money to aid. Lots of money.

events.text: A message arrives from [character]: “After the many kind words that [character] has spoken of you, I am convinced that you are a just follower of [religion]. Please allow me to send a gift to add to glory in [rival].” A generous offer, what will you ask for?

events.name: Intercessional Suspicion

options.text: Take no chances. If he makes a sudden move, kill him.
Meet alone as a show of trust.
Meet, but take your guards.

events.text: Your Spymaster [character] urgently asks to speak with you. He quickly relays that his agents are suspicious that during their meetings [character] has turned [character] against you and that there is a planned attempt on your life. A servant approaches to inform you that [character] is at the palace, asking to meet with you alone. [character] gives you a meaningful look. There is no time for proof, can [character] be trusted?

events.name: Intercessional Compulsion

options.text: [character] went too far.
Praise him for getting the desired results.
Smooth things over with the clergy.

events.text: [character] has returned to you with news of his intercession. Keep the oral tradition alive.

[character] is suggesting that a copy should be written for the first time to record his words for future generations. [character] argues that writing is unworthy to record such holy words. Remind [character] of my generous love.
They are not worth my time.

Imprison [character] for his plot against [character].

[character] seems shaken and taken aback by your sudden reverence and fervor. He asks you to explain your revelation.

[character] expects you to meet him at the gates and to guide him through the city yourself. The court ask if you will really humble yourself so before this man?

Have him improve relations with the leaders of [religion].

Cover for [character], but later remind him that he now owes you for this blunder.
Pass it off as a jest.

Call on the laws of tolerance to allow [religion] to spread.

Send some of your finest scribes to tutor [character].
Pay a learned scholar to join the court.

events.text: While learning the practices of [religion] from [character], the newly converted [character] has found a passion for reading the religious texts. He now spends most days taking the esoteric interpretations of various scholars and translating them into. The eager learner has approached you, asking for help to pursue this new calling. Will you provide aid?

events.name: Patriarch vs. Oligarch

options.text: [character] is right, [character] ought to convert.
[character] may keep his [religion] faith.

events.text: [character], the head of your State Religion of [religion], has been debating theology with [character], Oligarch of the [family] Family and a devout [religion]. [character] believes that having a non-[religion] among the Heads of our great Family constitutes a crisis of faith for our nation, and he is insistent that [character] convert to [religion]. [character], however, is quite content with his [religion] faith, and sees no need to bow to the [religion] establishment of [rival]. Both of them have now confronted you with this squabble in the royal palace. Will you tolerate the [religion] ways of [character], or pressure him to convert to your State Religion?

options.text: [character] makes some compelling arguments!
This is a fruitless endeavor.

events.text: Your attempts to convert [character] are met with open ears, although the [religion] founder proves unyielding. After you have had your say, he offers a thorough rebuttal, detailing the orders of the cosmos through his understanding.

events.name: Naming and Necessity

options.text: Sure thing.
Your name is [character], come along now.

events.text: [character] can barely contain his excitement and pride at being chosen for the royal house of [rival]. He looks at you, eyes serious, and says "I shall now be known as Shadowlightning, Foe of the Unworthy!"

events.name: [family] needs

options.text: Fine, see to whatever they demand.
I will not be extorted. [character] is not so special.

events.text: The [family] are, of course, thrilled that you want to elevate little [character] to the royal house. But naturally there remain administrative considerations, political realities, so many details that need handling. It should be no problem for the royal house of [rival] to smooth these over, shouldn't it?

events.name: A Spouse's Honors

options.text: We could use an Overseer of the Fields.
I shall grant the title of Possessor of Veneration.
How does Steward of the Chamber sound?

events.text: Late one evening at court, [character] comes to speak with you in private. "You have chosen to legitimize [character]. This action places me in an unpleasant position and will be seen as a snub by members of the court. Please, grant me additional honors to show that you still care for me."

events.name: A Bastard's Love

options.text: We shall support you. May your marriage be blessed.
I cannot accept this. You will be married to another.

events.text: During the celebrations of his legitimization, [character] takes you aside and introduces [character]. "[character], I have no right to ask this, but I shall. I love [character], and she carries my child." [character] waves a hand at the party. "Before all this, I dreamed of a simple life with her. But now, I risk being married off to someone else. Please, my [title], allow us to be married."

events.name: Noble Concerns

options.text: We should support the [family] Family as they support our actions.
Arrange for the [family] Family to receive a large shipment of food.
A gift of iron for the [family] Family would bring those daggers to our side.

events.text: [character] stops you outside the throne room, informing you of malicious whispers among the families about your recognition of the former bastard [character]. "It seems the [family] are in favor of the action, but the [family] don't like it on legal grounds, while the [family] have their knives out. It's a right mess all around as always." How shall we turn this to our advantage?

events.name: The Bastard's Body

options.text: We must launch an investigation into the murder.
Leave the matter alone. Further investigation will only bring heartache.
It is plain to see. [character] is the vile murderer!

events.text: The body of [character] is found at the bottom of a rocky ravine. Suspicions surround his untimely death, which may stem from envy over his recent legitimization. He was last seen in the gardens with [character], the evening before his body was discovered. Shall we investigate?

events.name: A Greater Calling Just Called

options.text: Can it really be such a bad life?

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: You do not refuse your King.

events.text: According to [character], being the chosen heir to the throne of [rival] would be an honor, of course... but he just has a lot to work on right now. In remote mountains, among the common people, or on a spiritual plane. he was a bit unclear, actually. But the upshot is staying well away from the throne and court politics.

events.name: No Time Wasted

options.text: "From here on"? You do know that I have no intention of stepping aside any time soon?
You know what, let's get to work on planning that coronation.

events.text: "You have made the right choice." [character] assures you. "I know it should be a weight off your shoulders that you have someone with vision and diligence to take the reins from here on."

events.name: Untimely

options.text: Had I not chosen [character], he would probably still be breathing...

events.text: A plummet to the death, with no witnesses. The demise of [character] comes a matter of only days after your announcement of his new status as heir of [rival]. Could your own flesh and blood be so murderous? Did shadowy foreign agents get so well placed? Or... was the pressure simply too much?

events.name: Recognition of Lover

options.text: This offer has merit, and we shall accept it.
No. The last embers of my love faded years ago.
I've only ever wanted you, my love.

events.text: Early in the morning, [character] comes to you with an offer. He asks that you not divorce him, which would subject both of you to the wrath of his Family. Instead, he suggests that you remain married to him, while also taking on your lover [character] as an additional husband. Shall we accept this offer?

events.name: The Schism of Marriage

options.text: Continue, no matter the cost.
Recant your request for a divorce.

events.text: Determined to remain [title], your spouse [character] has enlisted the help of [character] to try and thwart your attempts at a divorce. The [religion] [title] has united the and is threatening to spread discontent through their followers unless you agree to desist from this current course of action. Will religious intervention keep this marriage together?

events.name: Flight from [rival]

options.text: They are dead to me. We must choose a new heir.
We will dispatch soldiers to find and recover the Heir.
[rival] will regret its meddling.

events.text: Far away in [rival], the relatives of [character] learn of your divorce before it happens. Somehow, word reaches your husband and he escapes the country, taking the young heir along with him. The disappearance of [character] flusters the court. They await your reaction.

events.name: The Queen's Claim

options.text: I don't care what she claims. It is not my child.
Tell the doctors to consult the calendars.
Give [character] some gold to change his story.

events.text: Within several days of your divorce, [character] claims that she is pregnant with a child of royal blood. Skeptical, you demand the truth of the child's parentage, but [character] will not change her story, and she refuses the divorce. How do you wish to deal with this predicament?

events.name: Husband and Manservant

options.text: My Love, he's perfect.
I've changed my mind. I only need you, my love!
No, I cannot accept this offer. The divorce is final.

events.text: [character] comes to you late one night, after receiving your request for a divorce. "Husband, I have not borne you an heir, but I still care for you. Please take my manservant, [character], and enjoy relations with him so that we might have an heir." How will you respond?

events.name: In The Eyes of

options.text: No, my decision is made!
Very well, we shall remain wed.

events.text: The cries of anger from the gathered mob can be heard even from your private chambers. [character] wasted no time upon hearing of your intentions for a divorce, swiftly securing the support of [character], the Head of [religion]. He is determined to remain [title], and so together they roused the faithful of the city to protest against the divorce. Now the duo sit in your chambers, awaiting your answer. [character] reminds you of his power to denounce your name to the faithful. Will you continue with the divorce or is the risk of upsetting the [religion] too great?

events.name: Lover and Husband

options.text: Yes, yes, that sounds wonderful! Just put the knife away!
No. I will not bow to your wishes.
Ah my loves, you can't stop me.

events.text: Your lover, [character], whispering sweet nothings into your ear, blindfolds and binds you in your bedchamber, which smells of lavender and musk. A moment later, [character] removes the blindfold and greets you with a sight Eros might blush at. "My love, you've broken my heart with that request for a divorce, but [character] and I came to an understanding," [character] says and smiles wickedly, drawing a knife. "You can either marry us both, or one of us will hold you down while the other kills you. How does that sound, my love?"

events.name: Paternal Custody

options.text: Order soldiers to take by children by force.
Declare [character] and [character] to be illegitimate.
Identify loopholes in the law that deny him custody.

events.text: When your husband receives your demand for a divorce, he collects your children, [character] and [character] and retreats to his Family's estate in [city]. Shortly afterwards, you receive a message from one of his servants. "I hereby exert my paternal rights over the custody of our children. They will remain in my care."

events.name: Settlement Demand

options.text: I will pay the settlement for [character].
I withdraw my request for a divorce.
I will rid myself of [character] one way or another.

events.text: When [character] receives your written request for a divorce, he springs into action, alerting his entire extended Family, including [character]. Outraged by what he views as an illegal action, [character] demands that you pay a settlement to [character] immediately. If you do not accept, he claims the divorce will be unlawful and unacceptable.

events.name: Taking it Personally

options.text: Raise the alarms! Prepare the troops!

events.text: Mere hours after informing your husband of your divorce, you receive a knock on your door. [character] has gathered his most devoted servants and left [city] for [tribe] lands. It is not long before spies inform the court of movement along the border. The [tribe] have taken the affront to [character] very personally, and they are thirsty for vengeance.

events.name: The Witness

options.text: Divorce is not good enough for [character].
Once I have signed, execute all the servants.
Leave him on an island to live his remaining days alone.
I will do nothing, rather than stoop to his level.

events.text: [character] receives the divorce document with characteristic resolve, requesting that witnesses be present at the signing. The next day, he arrives with a trio of servants to complete the agreement. As you prepare to sign your name, one of the servants lunges towards you with a dagger in his hand. The assassin is easily subdued, and he is forced to reveal the identity of the plotter: your husband, [character].

outcomes.description: After some persuading, [character] has agreed to a divorce agreement.

events.name: A Broken Crown

options.text: Energize your troops and generals.
Honor him with a heartfelt speech.
Keep the assassination a secret... for now.

events.text: Scouts report increased activity along the nation's borders. We soon learn why... [character], the ruler of [rival], has been assassinated by members of his own council. This news has yet to reach the public, so we still have a chance to use it to our advantage.

events.name: Unwelcome Meeting

options.text: We will have to pay to keep this a secret.
Now [rival] will find out, all because [character]'s men weren't careful.
Let [rival] know we caught [rival] spies sneaking past the border.

events.text: [character] brings us concerning news. The agents he sent to infiltrate [rival] have returned home, without realizing that [rival] spies followed them from just outside the [rival] palace to our borders. Now [character] of [rival] is threatening to expose our little "expedition" in [rival]. Unless we pay up, of course.

events.name: Captured by Tribe

options.text: May the gods be merciful.

events.text: With a heavy heart, [character] delivers some tragic news. The agents he sent to infiltrate [rival] and recover vital intelligence were captured by a barbarian horde en route to their destination. [character] was unable to send a rescue party in time to save them. We have no further news of their fate.

events.name: Defectors

options.text: Welcome them to [rival]!

events.text: Good news from the gates of [city]! [character]'s infiltrators have returned from their journey inside the borders of [rival]. Their initial report claims that while they were unable to scout the extent of [rival] territory, they did convince several units of the [rival] military to defect. [city] rejoices at the arrival of these eager soldiers.

events.name: Double Agent

options.text: [character] should have been more thorough.

events.text: Spymaster [character] visits you with troubling reports from [rival]. His man on the inside, a tried and trusted infiltrator, turned out to be a double-agent working for the [rival] court. Not only has he returned to his home nation, but he has also revealed [rival] territory to our potential enemy.

events.name: Land Grab

options.text: This is an excellent development.

events.text: After many restless nights, [character]'s agents return from their mission to infiltrate the lands of [rival]. Our spies secured numerous pieces of intelligence, escaping the country without arousing any suspicion. In addition to their reconnaissance, the agents secured several areas of unpopulated land near our borders. With these seizures, [rival] will be able to continue its expansion.

events.name: Nobles Abroad

options.text: We must keep a close eye on the [family].

events.text: While infiltrating the Cities and villages of [rival], [character]'s agents encounter several traveling members of the [family] family. Knowing the [family] love of wine, our agents work to loosen the nobles' tongues. After a night of revels, our agents learn that [character] and some of the other [family] are plotting to usurp the throne.

events.name: Silver Linings

options.text: Something is better than nothing.

events.text: An update arrives from [character]. Unable to complete their infiltration mission, his agents attempted to make the journey worth their efforts. Visiting [rival] mines and farms along the border, they procured a supply of foreign delicacies for the return home. At least the expedition was not a total failure.

events.name: Veteran Agent

options.text: You must learn through experience.

events.text: Agents sent to [rival] by [character] have arrived back in the capital. They bear news of great success, along with maps and scrolls detailing the entirety of [rival] land. Without your knowledge, [character] traveled with the seasoned agents, and he picked up several useful skills along the way.

events.name: [rival] Exiles

options.text: Let them come.

events.text: [character]'s infiltrators return with an abundance of information about the [rival], their encampments, and the strengths and weaknesses of their military. But they are not alone... The agents bring a band of [rival] with them, exiles who wish to leave their homeland behind and settle in [rival].

name: Infiltrate Nation

outcomes.description: [character] has successfully infiltrated your rival's territory.
outcomes.name: Territory Infiltrated

events.name: Goodbye, [rival]

options.text: Give them a proper welcome.

events.text: Our vilification of the [rival] may have been meant for foreign governments, but it appears to be making its way to the populace. [character]'s agents report that several caravans of [rival] citizens have departed the country and are heading to [city] to resettle in [rival].

events.name: Successful Mission

options.text: It is about time he came around.

events.text: Agents sent by [character] to malign the [rival] leadership report success, causing much optimism in the court. [character] of the [family] is especially pleased. [character] has long been a critic of your leadership, but this latest triumph seems to be convincing him of your views.

events.name: Close to Power

options.text: The mission is to slander [rival], not to harm its ruler.
Instruct her to improve [character]'s view of us.

requirements.label: Covert / Herbalist
tip: The leader must have one of: Covert (a character trait); Herbalist

options.text: Our spy should slip something into [character]'s drink.

events.text: You are awakened before dawn by a frenzied [character]. According to his sources, the agent he sent to slander the [rival] government has found herself in a post close to the [title]. If we wish to strike [character], this is the time. We must act with decisiveness... or not at all.

events.name: Common Goals

options.text: This is excellent news.

events.text: [character] brings encouraging news to the court. His spies in [rival] have encountered agents of [rival], who are on a similar mission to spread misinformation. The two groups have decided to ally with each other. Our agents are now able to improve relations with [rival] while tearing down the reputation of [rival].

events.name: Diplomatic Disaster

options.text: Someone must pay for these mistakes.
This betrayal was unforeseen and regrettable.

events.text: Intelligence from [rival] reveals a troublesome development. The "loyal" agents sent by [character] have reportedly been accepting bribes from the [rival] court, and they are now spreading poisonous rumors about [rival]. Members of the court demand that [character] be punished, but others caution against impulsive action.

events.name: Growing Influence

options.text: This agent has proven resourceful.

events.text: While traveling in [rival], our foreign agent has fallen in with the entourage of the [rival] heir, [character]. She has been serving him a constant stream of positive impressions of [rival] and your rule. If our relationship with the current [title] sours, we can hopefully rely on the favor of the heir.

events.name: No More Secrets

options.text: The throne is responsible for this failure.
Clearly, the agent was not up to the task.

events.text: An ominous message arrives from [rival]. It seems that [character]'s agent has been captured and tortured by members of the [rival] military, and he has revealed many of the court's most confidential plans. The next morning, the agent's decapitated body is discovered on the road to [city].

name: Slander Nation

outcomes.description: [character] has successfully slandered your rival.
outcomes.name: Slander Spread

outcomes.description: [character] has successfully slandered your rival, but was exposed in the process.

events.name: Betrayal of the Faith

options.text: Well, I didn't see that coming.
Let's see if I can sweat this one out.
Bring my herbal satchel, quickly!

events.text: You walk beside [character], leading a procession of acolytes and priests. [character] calls out to stop the ritual and turns to you, drawing the sacrificial dagger of his office. In a swift motion, he stabs you. You instinctively dodge the blade, but the knife draws blood near your neck. Your guards kill [character] as numbness spreads from your wound. You collapse to the ground. Poison.

events.name: Poisoned

options.text: It doesn't matter who did it, but rather where it happened.
I've heard rumors that [character] might wish my death.
No. I don't know who it could be.

events.text: While you dine with [character] and [character], you notice the wine seems to have a lingering odor of bitter almonds and parsnips. As you leave the villa you collapse, vomiting blood and bile. When you awake, in bed, blackness clouds the edges of your vision. A kindly gray-eyed court doctor stares into your eyes, his brow creased with worry lines. "My [title], you've been poisoned. Frankly, it's a miracle you are breathing at all. Someone wants you dead. Have you any idea who?" It seems your attempt to assassinate [character] has backfired.

events.name: Last Kiss

options.text: The whole [family] family is responsible for this treachery.
[rival] is better off without him.
This is none of my concern.

events.text: After a royal feast, [character] and [character] return to their estate for a relaxing evening. [character] kisses his husband, pulls a dagger from his robes, and stabs him through the heart. He exits the estate and disappears into the shadows before fleeing the country. It is widely accepted that he was paid to kill his husband.

Steam achievement (if the target leads a rival nation): Assassinated Another Leader

events.name: The Things We Do

options.text: This is what it takes to rule.
I do what I must, even if I do not like it.

events.text: Your spymaster [character] brings news of the mission’s success. [character] has been slain with a mixture of hemlock, all without anyone knowing. You thank him for the news, before catching sight of your son [character] frozen in the entranceway, looking at you with a mixture of fear and disgust. How will you explain this to your compassionate son?

events.name: Assassination Betrayal

options.text: Admit your involvement and make amends.
Deny that you knew anything of a plot.

events.text: Your assassination plot has been revealed! In a grand spectacle, [character] confronts you publicly, demanding that you admit your involvement in the conspiracy. How do you respond to these allegations?

events.name: A Messy Affair

options.text: Comfort the [family] with a gift.
Launch a full investigation... but do nothing.
Make filthy jokes at [character]'s expense.
Mourn with all of [rival].

events.text: Late one evening, [character] is struck by an assassin's arrow and killed instantly. More notable than his murder is the method by which it was done. A rogue of diminutive stature crept inside the toilet and waited for [character] to heed his natural urges. The [family] family is furious about the affair, concerned more with the scandal of the toilet than with the actual murder.

events.name: An Ivory Box

options.text: Such a grisly business.

events.text: A gift arrives at the court, a weighty wooden box decorated with ivory and smelling faintly of myrrh. Within it you find a severed head. At a second glance you recognize the man as an assassin regularly in the employ of [character]. There is a note tucked inside the box. It reads, "Your man was a good fighter, but I was better." Undoubtedly this was the work of [character], the man you sent the former owner of this head after.

events.name: Dancing Bears

options.text: Throw another festival to help them forget.
Slaughter the remaining bears as reassurance.
Do nothing. I do not want the attention.

events.text: During a local festival in the capital of [city], a parade of captive animals thrill the crowds, including [character]. As a troupe of bears begins a comical dance, one of them raises an axe and races at [character]! It is an assassin in disguise. [character] manages to knock the killer aside, foiling his plan. However, the citizens of [city] may never be the same.

events.name: Deadly Revels

options.text: Toss our Spymaster in a cell and throw away the key.
Abdicate the throne in shame.
Confess to the murder and accidental death.

events.text: After a long day in court, many of our friends and patrons celebrate with revels in a nearby temple. Wine is served. Within minutes, [character] begins to choke and clutch and his throat. Poison! However, [character] is not the only victim. Soon [character] also turns purple and collapses on the floor. This assassination has gone horribly wrong.

events.name: Death Investigated

rewards.text: Steam achievement (if the target is an heir): Assassinated Heir
Steam achievement (if the target leads a rival nation): Assassinated Another Leader

options.text: Send the payment to keep your involvement secret.

rewards.text: Steam achievement (if the target is an heir): Assassinated Heir
Steam achievement (if the target leads a rival nation): Assassinated Another Leader

options.text: Ignore the threat.

events.text: Your spymaster reports the success: [character] was killed with a mixture made from the leaves of belladonna. A week passes before a message arrives from [character]: "I know that you killed my brother; my own agents are well versed with the plant you used. Luckily for you I agree that it was time for him to go. However, a modest payment will help secure my… discretion in the matter."

events.name: Failed Assassination

options.text: Slip the sentries gold to kill the assassins.
Blame the [family] family for the attempted murder.
Do nothing.

events.text: A great festival is held in [city], and thousands of celebrants come to participate in the revels and processions. Two assassins hide in plain sight, weapons covered in ceremonial wreaths. Following [character] during a rousing parade, the men attack, but they are disrupted by the chaos of the crowds. [character] escapes the assassination attempt, but his guards manage to take the assailants captive.

events.name: Fallen Spymaster

options.text: I must speak with [character], discretely. We leave at once.
I will not cower before these scoundrels. You may leave.
Lock the gates at once and send out an army to retrieve the spymaster!

events.text: A scout hurriedly bursts into the court and signals that he wishes to speak with you privately. With your permission he approaches the throne and leans in to your ear. "Your majesty, [character] was ambushed in the streets of the capital," The scout whispers. "He is gravely wounded and the doctors do not expect him to survive the night. He spoke of [character] and that your life may be at risk even now." What shall we do?

events.name: False Charges

options.text: Let this be a lesson to my enemies.

events.text: Redeeming several political favors, Spymaster [character] fabricates a series of false charges of treason against [character]. The court moves quickly, condemning [character] and passing a sentence of death. Despite his claims of innocence, [character] is crucified on a hill outside [city].

guaranteed.text: Steam achievement (if the target is an heir): Assassinated Heir
Steam achievement (if the target leads a rival nation): Assassinated Another Leader

events.name: Familial Revenge

options.text: What a mess...

events.text: You read the report that [character] still lives and, even worse, is now plotting against you. Reading on, you learn that the assassin cornered [character] early one morning en route to the market and was just about to strike when [character] saw the danger and jumped into the fray. Tackling the assassin to the ground, he managed to pin the assassin down until the guards arrived, holding on despite being struck again and again with the knife. The assassin was quickly killed, but not before revealing your name as the instigator of the plot. [character] is unlikely to rest until he has returned the favor.

events.name: Hired Killers

options.text: I shall dismiss these rumors with a speech.
It is important than we do not act rashly.
The court will root out all conspirators.

events.text: While surveying troops in the city of [city], [character] is set upon by a squad of armed soldiers and hacked to pieces. Apparently, someone paid these mercenaries to impersonate [rival] soldiers and infiltrate the camp with the purpose of assassinating [character]. Followers and friends of [character] suspect that [rival] may be to blame for the killing. How shall we address their theories?

events.name: Hostage Situation

options.text: Guards! Guards! Kill this assassin!
Attack [character] yourself.
Wait, we can talk this out.

events.text: As you enter your private chambers, a wild eyed [character] holds a knife to the throat of [character]. [character] bellows at you. "Not another step! I'll kill him!!" Sweat gleams on his forehead. "I know it was you. You tried to kill me!"

events.name: Last Stand

options.text: Let this be a lesson to my enemies.

events.text: While preparing for a diplomatic trip to [rival], [character] notices a group of masked figures surrounding his home. They start a fire and wait in hiding as the flames rise high into the sky. With no way out, [character] races from the building with a dagger in hand. He is cut down by a storm of assassins' arrows.

events.name: Missing the Mark

options.text: Perhaps gold can buy peace?
We will not be threatened.

events.text: [character] brings dire news that your assassin was killed before managing to kill [character]. The [rival] leaders are shocked that you would attempt such a brazen act against one of their subjects, and an ambassador arrives from [character]. Her steely gaze brokers no argument as she demands that you either pay tribute for the crime to barter a truce, or face war.

guaranteed.text: Steam achievement (if the target is an heir): Assassinated Heir
Steam achievement (if the target leads a rival nation): Assassinated Another Leader

events.name: Monkey Assassin

options.text: That went surprisingly well!

events.text: It is time for the ultimate test of whether your plan will work! One of your agents sneaks the monkey into the grounds of [character] home, releasing it with a small vial of poison. The well trained monkey darts in through the window without a second glance, the agent left to wait in tense anticipation. A minute later the monkey returns, the agent quickly knocking the apple from its mouth. After hearing the shocked cries as the body is found, the two steal back into the night to report their success.

events.name: Monkey Assassin

options.text: I should have seen that coming...

events.text: It is time for the ultimate test of whether your plan will work. One of your agents takes the monkey to the grounds of [character] home, releasing it with a small vial of poison. Your monkey darts in through the window without a backwards glance, but it only takes a moment for things go terribly, terribly wrong. The agent winces listening to the crashes and commotion throughout the house, and soon a plume of smoke starts to trail from the building as a fire caused by the hapless monkey catches the rafters. The agent reports that he saw people stream out of the building, [character] amongst them, badly burned but alive. The monkey was never seen again.

events.name: Of Dogs and Daggers

options.text: What kind of monster would do such a thing!

events.text: Late one evening, you enter your chambers. As you change out of the royal regalia, your faithful furry companion rests upon your bed in the next room. Suddenly, a low growl rumbles from your dog, followed by the sounds of a ferocious brawl and pained yelp. You rush into your bedroom, and find your dog dead on the floor, a dagger embedded in it's side with a note around the handle. The note contains a single line, "I have killed your assassin and your dog, consider yourself warned." You know this must be the work of [character].

guaranteed.text: Steam achievement (if the target is an heir): Assassinated Heir
Steam achievement (if the target leads a rival nation): Assassinated Another Leader

events.name: Parted by Death

rewards.text: Steam achievement (if the target is an heir): Assassinated Heir
Steam achievement (if the target leads a rival nation): Assassinated Another Leader

options.text: Close up the loose end.
There has been enough death already.

events.text: Your assassins have done their morbid work, slaying [character] on the steps of his home. However, things are by no means over. In the days leading up to his death, [character] shared his fears and suspicions with his husband, [character]. [character] has locked himself away since the murder. It may be grief, but your agents suspect that [character] is plotting his revenge. It would be tough to get to him, but your assassins believe they can finish the job.

events.name: Strangled!

options.text: Indulge [character]'s suspicions.
Give [character] your vote of confidence.

events.text: [character] is discovered dead in his bath. After examining the body, doctors believe that he was strangled. [character]'s husband, [character], accuses [character] of carrying out this heinous act. "The two were close, but they had recently suffered a falling out."

events.name: Suspicions Confirmed

options.text: Welcome him back to court with a speech.
Investigate rumors of corruption in the military.
Convince [character] that I am not involved.

events.text: While waiting in the street for his servants to fetch him, [character] is attacked by a man dressed as a soldier in the [rival] army. He manages to escape, and the would-be assassin is captured by the city guards. [character] is more convinced than ever that someone is plotting his murder.

guaranteed.text: Steam achievement (if the target is an heir): Assassinated Heir
Steam achievement (if the target leads a rival nation): Assassinated Another Leader

events.name: The Cycle Continues

options.text: We must be vigilant in the days ahead.

events.text: News reaches you that your assassins hit their mark, chasing down and slaughtering [character]. What they didn’t see was his son watching from behind a column, frozen in fear. Twisted by anger and grief, [character] is consumed with getting vengeance for the murder of his father. Mere days later, your heir [character] is assaulted when traveling through the city at night, barely escaping with his life.

events.name: The Lute Player

options.text: We will commission a song honoring [character].
The [family] have our deepest sympathies.

events.text: At a [family] birthday feast, a lute player sits before the assembled family to play a tune written for the occasion. Reaching the crescendo of the piece, the lute player stands and crushes the skull of [character] with a single blow. The celebration descends into chaos! As they recover the body of the slain assassin, the guards retrieve his lute. It is lined with a heavy bar of lead.

events.name: Tortured Assassin

options.text: We will try as many times as needed.
Get the assassin to tell you everything he learned about [character]'s defences.
Chastise [character] for allowing such a mistake.

events.text: Gasps echo through the hall as the man drags himself forwards, bloody and chained. You can see roughly stitched wounds criss-crossing his arms and few teeth left in the cracked mouth. [character] appears beside you and gravely whispers that it is the assassin that was sent to deal with [character]. As all but your most trusted are cleared from the room, the assassin approaches and confirms your suspicions - that he was caught and tortured before completing his task, and has now been sent back with a message from [character].

events.name: Watch Your Head

options.text: Let this be a lesson to my enemies.

events.text: While frequenting his favorite brothels, [character] finds himself smitten with a captivating young woman. The two adjourn to a smaller chamber, where they partake of wine and each other's company. Once [character] becomes drunk, his young admirer draws a dagger from her cloak and beheads him. The head is never found.

[character] suggests that [character] could be put to good use, but can this foreign agent be trusted?

events.text: Your guards move efficiently through [city] in their hunt for agents, following every lead and sweeping the city inch by inch. When they break into a suspected inn they find tablets with messages showing that, although there is no agent network in [city], one of their agents traveled through here recently, resting for a few days before traveling on to either [city] or [city]. One of these cities is likely occupied by an Agent Network. But which?

guaranteed.text: Exposes a foreign agent network in the city
Exposes a foreign agent network in the city

events.name: Two Birds

options.text: If only all my subjects were as effective!

events.text: [character] has surpassed himself, hunting down a cabal of agents in [city] with ruthless efficiency. Leading the guards in storming a grain merchant’s shop that was being used as a front, [character] caught the agents and their possessions before they were destroyed. The seized messages prove that there is also an agent network in [city]. The spies are quickly hunted down and removed from the city.

events.text: Upon reaching [city], [character] is surprised to be greeted in person by [character], the governor of the city. The Governor makes a point of insisting that [character] will stay as a special guest of the city, accompanied by dignitaries at all times. Such a watchful eye will make it difficult to set up a new agent network, with [character] reporting every movement back to [character].

events.name: A Little More Time

rewards.text: Exposes a foreign agent network in the city

Call off the hunt and scavenge what you can of the mission’s resources.

events.text: [character] has led his agents on the hunt for foreign agents in [city], tearing apart suspected hiding places and trailing suspected agents. Despite a number of leads, there has been no definitive evidence of an agent network. With resources for the mission running low, [character] requests more time and resources for his search.

options.text: Capture and kill him as soon as possible.
Send agents to follow [character] and discover the enemies' plans.
Have [character] make contact, pretending to be a traitor.

events.text: [character] approaches with a delicate matter. He has discovered an enemy agent, [character], in [city]. Your Spymaster [character] is visibly excited by the news, pacing back and forth and muttering plans to himself. There is a unique opportunity to turn the situation to your advantage, one not to be wasted! How will you deal with this unwanted guest?

events.name: Influence in Court

options.text: Ruin the [rival] Heir's reputation.
Slow and complicate the governing process.

events.text: Somehow, resourceful [character] has positioned himself as a servant in the court of [city], where he is able to overhear the city's leaders. After several weeks, he begins to carefully exert influence over the weakest courtiers, pushing them towards policies hurtful to [rival] and helpful to [rival].

events.name: Steal Away

options.text: Kill the hostage. Our message should be clear.
That is a less subtle approach than I expected, but the hostage may prove valuable.
[character] is a fool. Return the hostage before more damage is done.
Bring our guest to me. We may yet have a place for them.

events.text: During [character]’s time in [city], he has managed to gain the trust and friendship of one of [rival]’s key nobles. While the two are out on an unaccompanied airing in the woods near [city], [character] sees an opportunity to steal away with his companion at knife point. Word soon arrives that [character] has returned to [city] with his hostage. What is to be done about the situation?

events.name: [rival] Plotters

options.text: Storm the hideout and attempt to slay the plotters.
Befriend them, and lead them into a trap.
Ignore them. We will handle them here in [rival].

events.text: While preparing to launch a campaign of subterfuge against [city], [character] encounters a group of radical [rival] plotting their own attacks against us. They have their gaze firmly locked on [city], where they plan to incite rebellion and weaken military outposts. [character] and his men await your command.

events.name: Caught in the Act

options.text: One setback will not discourage us.

events.text: Agents, personally accompanied by [character], attempt to surveil the outer walls of [city], but they are discovered by guards on their nightly rounds. A fight breaks out, and [character] is injured trying to escape. One of the other agents is killed by an arrow to the back.

events.name: A Way In

options.text: Tell him to proceed with caution.

events.text: While seeking ways to sow discord among the citizens of [city], [character] befriends a charming stranger in one of the city's many wine houses. This young man turns out to be [character], Heir to the [rival] throne. In addition to committing malicious acts to weaken the city, [character] has dedicated himself to turning [character] to our side.

events.name: Agent Caught

options.text: Make an example of him to deter any other agents.
Recruit him to serve you and [rival].
Convince him to share the secrets of those who left him to rot.

events.text: [rival] is growing bold. Stealing into [city] during the night, their agent [character] attempted to sabotage the streets and bridges that keep the city running. Thankfully, [character] was caught before any serious harm was done. Now [rival] is denying any involvement, leaving their agent in your hands. What will you do with the would-be saboteur?

events.name: Agent Secrets

options.text: See if your Spymaster [character] can learn the secrets of these devices.
Break the failed contraptions down for their components.
Send the devices with an ambassador to be returned to [rival].

events.text: Dark plumes of smoke rise from the [city] storehouses. Treachery is afoot! Within the stores, your guards find strange contraptions of metal, wood and oil. Fortuitously these devices, obviously intended to start fires, did not work as expected and only created an acrid, but harmless, smoke. Your guards at the gates report seeing [character] and his [rival] accomplices fleeing into the night.

events.name: Death to Spies

options.text: [rival] will pay for this!

events.text: Pounding on the door! Shouts from the corridor! [character], our Agent in [city], has been discovered! Members of the city militia crash through [character]'s door and seize him, dragging him out into the busy streets. The next day, he is executed publicly to the roars of [rival] crowd.

events.name: Misinformation

options.text: Undermine the local and national leadership.
Cause confusion and discord among the people.

events.text: Among [character]'s agents in [city] are several former scholars who have dedicated themselves to the security of our beloved [rival]. They have envisioned a plot to spread misinformation about the city's leadership. Distributing written propaganda and giving speeches in the marketplaces, they are able to strike [city] where it's most vulnerable. Where should they focus their efforts?

events.name: Strike at the Heart

options.text: Attack those in line at recruitment centers.
Set fire to military buildings and barracks.

events.text: Completing his assignments with admirable speed, [character] proceeds to enact plots to damage the growing [rival] might. He gathers a team of resourceful spies and soldiers to strike at the heart of their military. [character] is eager to launch these efforts, but he needs to know what locations to target.

options.text: Reveal this scandalous affair to agitate the rebels.
I will help the young lovers keep their secret.

events.text: While investigating ways to turn the people of [city] against their rulers, [character] uncovers a shocking piece of information: [character], the young [rival] Heir, has been seen in the company of our own [character]. It appears that the two youths are engaged in a secret love affair in defiance of their Family and nations. We could use this gossip to further our interests in [city], though at the expense of our standing with the [family].

events.name: The Slave King

options.text: Let [city] burn.

events.text: [character]'s actions to trigger a rebellion in [city] have proven too successful. Led by an inspiring youth who claims to be "chosen" by the gods, slaves in [city] have overthrown their masters. The city teems with violence, as [rival] nobles are murdered in the streets. Unable to escape the carnage, [character] falls to the mob.

events.name: The Finger

options.text: Return the finger to his family.

Insurrection The Finger Ambition Four Agent Networks

events.text: After befriending several outspoken [rival] rebels, [character] agrees to meet with their leader in a secret location. Unfortunately, the meeting is a trap. When [character] arrives, several members of the elite [rival] army await him. The military has been working to root out dissidents for months. The last message you receive from [character] is written in someone else's hand, and it includes a severed finger wrapped in cloth.

events.name: Out of Touch

options.text: He is dead to us.

events.text: For several weeks, communication with [character] has been slow, challenged by a series of weather events and a shortage of messengers. But only when the latest update arrives do we learn the truth: [character] has defected to the [rival] court. With our Agent goes any plot for Insurrection.

events.name: Agent Bribe

options.text: Thank [character] and keep the money for yourself.
Offer the wealth to [character] if he is willing to join your court.
Let [character] keep it for protecting you against these schemes.

events.text: There are many tests of loyalty when serving under the rule of a [title], but [character] has passed this particular one. After being approached by the [rival] agent [character], offering a hefty bribe for starting an insurrection, [character] takes the payment and comes straight to you. Now both the gold and the fate of [character] are in your hands.

events.name: Agent Offer

options.text: Refuse to listen to the lies.
Execute [character] as a traitor.
Set both free, but let them know that you are watching every movement.

events.text: Your Spymaster brings news that a [rival] agent, [character], has been caught trying to instigate an insurrection in [city]. When you question him, the foreign agent is suprisingly open and offers to join you, quickly claiming that [character] has agreed to take a bribe to help the [rival]. Will you take action on [character] word?

events.name: Eager [rival]

options.text: They should be encouraged to win back their homeland.
We will settle for eager immigrants to [rival].
Send additional Agent to support both options.

events.text: [character]'s efforts in [city] seem to be bearing fruit, but instead of rising to overthrow the city's leadership, the rebels have another plan in mind. They appeal to the court for asylum in [rival]. They would rather start their lives anew than sacrifice them to a lost cause. Messengers from [character] ask us for our decision.

events.name: Protected by the People

options.text: Throw a huge celebration to thank of the people of [city].
Have the execution take place in front of the gathered mob.

events.text: The [rival] plans to start an insurrection in [city] did not go as they expected. When their agent [character] tried to rile the crowd against you, the people instead turned on the hapless instigator in a rather dramatic display of loyalty to you. Marching to the palace, the people throw the agent before your throne with calls for his blood. Will you make an example of [character], or focus on thanking the people while he quietly 'disappears'.

[character] new collaborators warn that [city] belongs to the [family], a militaristic family known for their harsh rule. Their guards are trained and numerous. [character] has sent a warning that gaining information will be difficult with such a tight watch. How will you direct him to proceed?

options.text: This armor will be mine. Do what you must.

rewards.text: Your agent network moves to the target city

events.text: While setting up a network of agents in [city], [character] hears of an artifact held in a vault in the center of the city: A legendary set of armor said to belong to of [rival]. It is a treasure of national fame and importance. [character] believes that his network has found an opening to steal this treasure for you. However, such an action would send the city into lockdown, making it impossible to set up a new network in the city.

[character] has explained that he is aiming to steal the [rival] plans for [tech]. [rival] is open to striking a deal if you are amenable to working together. If not, the glowering agent makes clear, then [rival] does not appreciate a rival network in the same city.
