description: Meet with religious leaders to improve the Religion's Opinion Religion

events.name: Spreading the Faith

options.text: We will consider sending Disciple to convert the [tribe] to [religion].

events.text: A message arrives from the High Synod of [religion]: "We are delighted that you have sent [character] to visit us, as we have been meaning to speak with you about a pressing matter. You are not at War with the godless [tribe], and yet you have made no effort to bring the light of [religion] to those heathen tribesmen. We task you with sending a Disciple to the [tribe] to convert them to [religion]. If you do this, we will be greatly pleased with you."

events.name: [title] On Trial

options.text: Apologize for any wrong-doings and humbly promise to do better.
Blame any and all mistakes on [character].
Argue that any failure to follow doctrine reflects their own religious guidance.
Leave this charade of a council.

events.text: The [religion] High Synod have asked you to speak at their meeting. However, what at first seemed like a sign of respect turns out to be more like a trial, with the leaders of faith questioning your every action that deviated from religious creed in even the slightest way. After reading out a list of the perceived misdemeanors, there is an awkward pause as they wait for your reply. How will you handle this upstart religious council?

events.name: A Faith Divided

options.text: Agree to the demands of the [religion] faction.

events.text: [character] struggles to keep control of the High Synod as rebelling clamor to make themselves heard. The divisions in the faith run deeper than you knew, the religious leaders completely divided on the key rites that make up [religion] practice. The rebellious demand to be heard, proclaiming that [theology] is a core part of the [religion] worship. The brash faction claim that to deny the theology is an attack on, an attack that will be met with violence.

events.name: Demands of the Synod

options.text: Accept their charge.
Give a vague answer about helping the religion.

events.text: The leaders of [religion] gather at the High Synod to discuss matters of theology and state. Although the view on your rule is largely favorable, the determine that more places of worship are needed to give the proper respect due to. Will you commit to raising these new buildings for [religion]?

events.name: A Stone of Fire

options.text: Leave the philosopher to his fate.
Encourage the sentence to be exile instead.
Recruit the philosopher to your court.

events.text: The High Synod has become embroiled in the case of [character], a philosopher and scientist known for investigations into natural phenomena such as eclipses and meteors. His findings even claim that the sun is a fiery incandescent stone, even larger than [rival]. The philosopher is charged with impiety, but has requested your intervention in the courts. Will you risk angering the [religion] leaders to help this scientific mind?

events.name: Charged with Corruption

options.text: [character] is to be deposed, stripped of all titles and sent to exile.
[character] is right, he deserves a fair trial.

requirements.label: Corrupt / Schemer
tip: The leader must have one of: Corrupt; Schemer

options.text: Pay bribes for the charges to be dropped and stability restored.

events.text: You have been asked to preside over the [religion] High Synod, at which the religious head [character] is to defend himself against charges of corruption. A group of led by [character], claim that [character] commanded soldiers to burn their homes after falsely claiming that they were dissidents. Brought forth to apologize, [character] refuses to recognize the legality of a Synod in which his open enemies are sitting as judges. Your advisors suggest that this could be a chance to rid yourself of the upset [title], although the leader remains popular with many of the [rival] populace.

events.name: Food for The Faithful

options.text: We will make a donation of food to the [religion].
We have no resources to spare.

events.text: [character] has paid a visit to the venerable High Synod of [religion], offering our services and favor. The [religion] council is pleased that we have come to them, for indeed they are in need of assistance. Some of the faithful poor are starving, and the [religion] elders expect us to support the struggling believers in exchange for their blessings. Shall we make a donation to the [religion] poor?

events.name: Funds for The High Synod

options.text: We will make a donation to the [religion].
Our initial gesture is sufficient for now.

events.text: [character] has visited the High Synod of [religion], offering to favor their religion. Although the [religion] council is pleased that we have finally shown them some respect, they are not content with mere flattery. The faith is in need of funds, and the [religion] elders expect financial support in exchange for their blessings. Shall we make a donation to [religion]?

events.name: Higher Expectations

options.text: I have seen the light! [religion] will become our State Religion.
Our initial gesture is sufficient for now.

events.text: [character] has visited the High Synod of [religion] as a royal envoy, in recognition of their status. However, the [religion] council is hardly pleased at receiving some mere accolades, as they are far from satisfied with our current level of commitment to the faith. The High Synod of [religion] demands that [rival] shows its commitment to following the faith, lest we lose favor with them. Shall we adopt [religion] as our State Religion to placate the High Synod?

events.name: Holy Stone

options.text: We will finance repairs for the [religion] High Synod.
We have no stone to spare.

events.text: [character] has paid a visit to the venerable High Synod of [religion], offering our services and favor. The [religion] council is pleased that we have come to them, for they are in dire need of assistance. Their ancient temples and headquarters are crumbling, and badly in need of repairs. The [religion] elders expect us to supply the raw materials needed for the renovations in exchange for their blessings. With a generous donation of Stone we can placate the council. Shall we make such a donation to the [religion]?

events.name: Homes for The Faithful

options.text: We will make a donation of building supplies to the [religion].
We have no wood to spare.

events.text: [character] has paid a visit to the venerable High Synod of [religion], offering our services and favor. The [religion] council is pleased that we have come to them, for indeed they are in need of assistance. Some of the faithful poor are living on the streets, and the [religion] elders expect us to support the struggling believers in exchange for their blessings. With a generous donation of Wood, they should be able to house the homeless. Shall we make such a donation to the [religion] poor?

events.name: In Heaven, as on Earth

options.text: Use this newfound fervor to recruit disciples.
Offer your aid to spread the city of God on earth.

events.text: The Synod has an invigorating effect on the [religion] religion. [character] rallies the church together with an impassioned speech, re-imagining the church and clergy as a city of God that is immune the rise and fall of earthly empires. As the Presbyters and Bishops return to their communities, there is a wave of new ideas and a fervor previously unseen in the faithful.

events.name: Peace Among The Faithful

options.text: We will seek better relations with the [rival].
We have no desire to change our diplomatic relationship with the [rival].

events.text: [character] has visited the High Synod of [religion], but the [religion] council is less than pleased with us. The [religion] elders want there to be peace among the faithful, and yet we are not on the friendliest terms with the [rival]. In fact, the [religion] elders are demanding that we attempt to come to terms with the [rival], and reach out to them with an offer of Player Peace.

events.name: The Cadaver Synod

options.text: [character] must be struck from the records.
Side with the dissenting voice.

events.text: The [religion] High Synod has taken a rather unexpected turn. Once the required are all gathered, [character] proceeds to bring out the exhumed body of [character] and places the once-Patriarch on trial for charges of sedition and perjury. The members of the Synod seem convinced of their previous leader's guilt, although a lone dissenter suggests that the religion should use this example to demonstrate the power of Redemption through the <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>fires of Ahura Mazda<p=SUBJECT_CHRISTIANITY>death of Christ<p=SUBJECT_JUDAISM>laws of the Torah<p=SUBJECT_MANICHAEISM>wisdom of Mani<else>prayers of the faithful<end>. The lone asks you to intervene. Will you practice forgiveness, or strip the dead of his titles?

events.name: The Favored Family

options.text: The court will do all it can for the [family] family in the name of [religion]
We cannot lend our support right now.

events.text: The High Synod of [religion] is pleased that you have reached out to the faith, sending a delegation to your court to improve relations. During their visit, they propose that we should show special favor to the [family], as they are devout adherents of [religion]. Diverting funds to the [family] would show the followers of [religion] that the throne means to support them.

events.name: The High Synod

options.text: We will further intertwine our fate with the [religion].
Our initial gesture is sufficient for now.

events.text: [character] has visited the High Synod of [religion], offering to favor their religion. The [religion] council is pleased that we have finally come to recognize the legitimacy of their faith. In fact, the [religion] leaders seem amenable to further flattery.

outcomes.description: The High Synod organized by [character] has improved our standing with the clergy.

subject: Ambassador

description: Bribe the Family with gifts to improve their Opinion Family

events.name: Never Enough

options.text: We should start production in [rival].
It is better to continue importing such comforts.
I will no longer pay for the [family] bad habits.

events.text: Sometimes too much is never enough. The insatiable [character] and his family, unsatisfied with their lives of plenty, have petitioned the court for even more imports to slake their lust for fine goods. The constant consumption and wanton spending is taking its toll on the treasuries. One option to remedy the [family] greed would be to increase production of these items inside [rival]. Or we could continue to ship them in from afar for our vassal families.

events.name: Family Politics

options.text: Ignore [character]'s warnings.
Reduce [character]'s influence on the court.
Attempt to win [character]'s trust.

events.text: Upon receiving the gift from Chancellor [character], [character] of house [family] visits you in the palace. He reveals that there are elements within the family that wish to see your downfall, most notably [character]. It is [character]'s advice that we remove [character] from any important roles on the court.

events.name: What is Art?

options.text: Bring it out only when the [family] visit.
Salvage it for needed stone.
This is beyond compare! A Masterpiece!
Display it outside the court as a show of gratitude.

events.text: Pleased with the gifts you sent with Chancellor [character], the [family] family has chosen to reciprocate. [character] returns to the palace with a life-size statue of your likeness. Sadly, it is not very flattering. Or very good. In fact, some consider it a monstrosity. What shall we do with this "gift?"

events.name: Our City

options.text: The [family] may have [city].
They ask too much!
Convince them that [city] is a joyless burden.

events.text: Members of the [family] wish to meet with the Council in private, away from prying eyes. Privately, they present a list of complaints and grievances, threatening to oppose future policies if the treatment of their family does not change. As recompense, they demand that we give them full authority over the city of [city].

events.name: Chastened

options.text: No [rival] noble family can resist fine luxuries.
Send the gift to the [family]. They will appreciate it.
Recover as much of the lost money as we can.

events.text: Chancellor [character] returns to the palace, chastened. He relates what happened when he visited the [family] estate, where he was accused of trying to bribe members of the family to align themselves with the throne. Our efforts with the [family] have reached an impasse. What shall we do?

events.name: Delivery Mistake

options.text: Make amends to the [family] with another gift.
Claim that the gift was for the [family] all along.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: Remove [character] for this terrible mistake.

events.text: Confusion among the royal messengers leads to a diplomatic blunder. The gifts meant for the [family] family have been delivered to members of the [family] instead. Effects of the debacle can be felt in court, as courtiers of both families accuse the other of plotting and misdeeds. What shall we do?

events.name: Devoted Followers

options.text: The court will do all it can for [religion].
We cannot lend our support right now.
My faith is between me and the divine.

events.text: The [family] family is grateful for Chancellor [character]'s generosity, and they host him for a friendly banquet at their estate. During the meal, they propose that we lend additional support to the [religion] movement, a cause to which they have devoted themselves. More funds would show the followers of [religion] that the throne means to support them.

events.name: In Your Honor

options.text: A formal exhibition of [rival] arts and culture.
A binge of wine, song, and social merrymaking.
No celebration is required. The gift speaks for itself.

events.text: Chancellor [character] returns from the [family] estate with good news. The [family] are so pleased with our gifts that they wish to host a celebration in your honor in [city]. No expense will be spared. What type of festivities would you prefer?

events.name: Unexpected Feelings

options.text: I am flattered, but no thank you.
We should explore this possibility.

events.text: Chancellor [character]'s mission to win the support of the [family] family has ended successfully. However, there has been an unexpected outcome. [character], of house [family], now believes that you have some personal interest in him. He requests that you visit the [family] estates to spend some quality time together.

events.name: A Kind Gesture

options.text: If they are willing to play this game, then so am I.
Perhaps another time.

events.text: [character] visits the estate of the [family] family, bearing gifts. While they clearly understand the motivation behind such a gesture, they do not refuse it. In fact, [family] seem amenable to further endearments.

name: Family Gifts

outcomes.description: Your vassal family appreciates the gifts that [character] brought from you.
outcomes.name: Gifts Please the Family

outcomes.description: Your vassal family appreciates the gifts that [character] brought, but your other subjects view this pandering as a sign of weakness.
outcomes.name: Gifts Expose our Weakness

outcomes.description: The Family Gift Mission of [character] has led to an event...
outcomes.name: Family Gift Event

subject: Chancellor

description: Attempt to increase Happiness in a City

events.name: Hunger in [city]

options.text: Hire additional physicians to treat those in [city].
Buy food from other nations to feed the hungry.
We will not take action.

events.text: Malnourishment in [city] has taken a tragic toll on the city's children, and leaders cry out for their king's mercy. Doctors are needed to treat the weak and ill, and food must be provided to feed starving families. We must take emergency action before this situation intensifies.

events.name: Market Unrest

options.text: Establish organized guilds across [rival].
Invest in trade reform in [city].
Assemble a council to review monetary laws.
There is nothing we can do right now.

events.text: Civil unrest in the markets of [city] threaten to erupt across the empire. Our refusal to form trade guilds has roiled the public. The [family] family has asked the court to reconsider our decision against allowing merchants to band together for better prices and more control. Something must be done before our economy suffers.

events.name: Seditious Meetings

options.text: Arrest [character] on charges of treason against [rival].
The court should investigate political reform in [city].

requirements.label: Charming character / Inspiring / Blessed
tip: The leader must have one of: Charming character (a character trait); Inspiring; Blessed

options.text: I will speak to these gatherings in person.

events.text: Citizens of [city] have reported secret meetings held by followers of [character], during which he gives seditious speeches against your rule. These regular events have driven up resentment in the capital, and the court worries about their enduring effects. We should intervene now, before conditions worsen.

events.name: Divine Intervention

options.text: May [city] continue to grow and thrive.

events.text: [character]'s agents in [city] have found a reliable partner in the [religion] leadership. Not only have they been able to reduce corruption and address unhappiness, but they have chosen to increase the church's influence across the city. It seems that this work was blessed.

events.name: Send Him Out!

options.text: We will give them [character].
They ask for too much. Teach them obedience.
I will meet with leaders of the rebellion.

events.text: The bumbling arrival of [character]'s agents in [city] inspires open rebellion in the streets. Crowds grow violent, torching dwellings and attacking [rival] guards. The leaders of the rabble call for the Chancellor to be handed over to them. If not, they will continue their destructive march across the city and beyond.

events.name: [rival] Pride

options.text: We will add one of their number to the court.
Form militias of those willing to fight.
Host national celebrations in [city].

events.text: [character]'s efforts to sway public opinion in [city] have proven successful... with some unexpected results. Several young leaders have arisen from the forge of local politics, and we could use their support to shore up loyalty. There are also groups of eager fighters in search of a new cause. We should take advantage of this renewed boon in [rival] pride.

events.name: In the Balance

options.text: Remove the Governor. He will be replaced.
Refuse their demands.
Establish a new guard to restore order.

events.text: When the citizens of [city] learn that we have sent agents to quell the unrest, mobs descend on the governor's palace. Forcing their way inside, they take Governor [character] and his court hostage. What shall we do? [character]'s life hangs in the balance. The people demand new leadership.

events.name: Local Corruption

options.text: Those responsible must be purged and punished.
Allow [character] to choose how to handle this matter.
Punish some for show, and send all future gold to the throne.

events.text: As [character]'s agents work to ease tensions in [city], they discover a history of rampant local corruption. Judges, military officers, and politicians have built a convoluted bureaucratic nightmare for the city's citizens, skimming taxes to fill their own pockets. We must demand action from Governor [character]!

events.name: The City Steps

options.text: He would make a good governor.
We will keep an eye on this man of the people.
The royal treasury will invest in [city]'s ongoing debate.

events.text: On a recent visit to the city of [city], [character] and his retinue encounter a throng of angry citizens crowding the city market. A series of impassioned speakers decry the poor conditions of [city] and their effects on the people. Between speeches, [character] climbs the steps and gives a calming oration, addressing the grievances and assuring support.

events.name: Treason in [city]

options.text: [character] has done me a great service.

events.text: While uprooting the causes of [city]'s discontent, our agents have heard rumblings of a plot engineered by [character] of the [family] family. These machinations are meant to destabilize the local government and turn the people against the throne. Thankfully, Chancellor [character] has arrested [character] for treason, and the [family] are trying to distance themselves from their unruly relative.

events.name: Well Connected

options.text: Bring him into my confidence.
The court will recognize his achievement.
It is wise to honor the whole family.

events.text: Surprisingly, [character] proves instrumental in helping Chancellor [character] pacify the citizens of [city]. It seems he possessed powerful connections among the city's elite. How shall we reward your subject for his assistance?

name: Pacify City

outcomes.description: [character] has listened to the grievances of the City's rulers and has reduced Discontent.
outcomes.name: Pacification Successful

outcomes.description: [character] has listened to the grievances of the City's rulers and has reduced Discontent, but this pandering has weakened your reputation.
outcomes.name: Pacification Exposes our Weakness

subject: Chancellor

events.name: A Hero's Flight

options.text: We must keep a careful watch for [character].

events.text: From the moment we condemned [character], crowds in the capital have voice their displeasure, especially soldiers and members of the military. [character] has a strong following among the fighting men and women. When guards reach [character]'s estate, they discover that he has slipped away with members of his household. Now a fugitive, he will become an even greater foe.

events.name: A Viper in the Nest

options.text: Clearly, there are traitors in our midst.

events.text: Someone in the court must be working closely with [character], as he was learned of his jail sentence ahead of time and fled. We will muster a search party at once, but we can make no assurances of his speedy apprehension.

events.name: Pretty Persuasion

options.text: I have received the [family] message. Release [character].
Justice in court will not be bought and sold.
Keep the riches and uphold the arrest. The [family] are fools.

events.text: You have only just given the order for [character]'s arrest, when a strange servant arrives at your chamber door laden with a heavy sack. She bows courteously and leaves the sack with you. Peering inside, you discover a small trove of glittering gold and gems. The stamp of the noble house of [family] has been branded into the sack's fine goatskin. It is a reminder of the power this family wields over every decision - even yours.

events.name: Unlikely Allies

options.text: Release them. I do not wish to race into war with [rival].
We will not tolerate ultimatums. [rival] must learn its place.

events.text: Guards sent by Chancellor [character] attempt to arrest [character], but they encounter resistance from an unlikely source: [rival]. It seems that [character] had been conspiring with the [rival] to push beneficial laws through the court. Now we have a band of them languishing in our prison. [character] demands that we release these men along with [character], and allow them to return to [rival]. Of course, showing such amnesty will be interpreted as a sign of weakness.

events.name: A Measured Voice

options.text: [character] is right, we must spare [character].
I must show resolve in the face of uncertainty, and he must be punished.

events.text: The decision is made. Guards have been sent to apprehend [character] and send him to the deepest dungeon. However, as you sit on the throne, unable to calm your thoughts, your husband [character] lingers by your side. "This act will only inflame the people's discontent," he explains. "They look to you for wisdom. Imprisoning such a measured voice will only confirm their fears."

outcomes.description: [character] has been imprisoned on charges that are generally agreed to be just.
outcomes.name: Target Justly Imprisoned

outcomes.description: [character] has been imprisoned on blatantly spurious charges. Some are accusing you of tyranny.

outcomes.description: [character] has been released from prison and has not been shy about complaining of unjust imprisonment.

His self effacing take on life and our place under the gods has had a marked effect on the impressionable pupil. As [character] steeps himself in these mystical teachings, you can't help but wonder if this education turn out the way you had hoped.

options.text: Assemble an expedition to find [character]!
There is nothing we can do.
Reach out to our friends for information.

events.text: When servants go to wake [character] for his studies, they find him missing. A check of the tutor's chamber finds [character] gone as well. After a tense investigation by the palace guards, the truth surfaces. [character] was an agent working for an unknown foreign power, and he has absconded with the heir.

events.name: Unhealthy Interests

options.text: I will take [character] under my wing.
Agree with [character] to keep an eye on [character].
We should let children be children.
Convince [character] to find other interests.

events.text: [character], tutor of [character], comes to you with a dismaying story about his student. It seems the child has shown an unhealthy interest in poisons, asking how to mask their presence in food. He has recently been spotted lurking in the palace kitchens.

options.text: Rebuke [character] disobedience.
Rebuke [character] incompetence.

events.text: They say that failure is the best teacher. [character] has, by this standard, perfected the teaching process. Conflicting accusations render the details unclear, but it is fair to say that all parties regard [character] tutoring sessions as time wildly misspent.

events.name: Family Favor

options.text: Nothing will come of it.
Forbid [character] from further visits.
Threaten the [family] with repercussions.

events.text: In a blatant attempt to win the favor of the young, the [family] family has extended an invitation to [character] and his student [character]. They serve fine food and drink, perform impressive military drills, and entertain with verse and song. Is this generosity harmless, or do the [family] wish to turn your successors against you?

events.name: Rule of Law

options.text: The ruler is the final judge of what is right.
Authority rests with the consensus of the court.
Judges and orators speak for the people.

events.text: For several days in a row, [character] takes his young student, [character], to the city courts to observe legal proceedings. When asked about his opinions on the law's influence over politics, [character] responds.

events.name: The Lion

options.text: Allow him to learn about lions from scholarly reports.
Command him to examine the lion personally.

events.text: In a stroke of good luck, [character] has come into possession of a "lion" named Oliver, a rare exotic creature from the south. He wishes to use the beast in one of [character]'s science lessons, but the boy is reluctant. All it took was one look at the cat's enormous teeth. Shall we insist on this firsthand experience?

options.text: Encourage him to support charitable government policies.
Suggest that he continue working directly with the poor.

events.text: Once a week, [character] brings his young pupil to the slums of [city], where [character] feeds the poorest of the poor. The teacher insists that such a lesson is vital in shaping future leaders. [character] appears to be benefiting from this exposure.

events.name: Ancient Lessons

options.text: The past is beyond us, and we must look to the future.
Clearly, these ancient peoples were inferior to us.
We must do all we can to learn from their mistakes.

events.text: One day, [character] and [character] take a tour of recently unearthed ruins with a learned scholar. They lay hands on ancient carvings, sketch the facade of a fallen temple, and explore the depths of an underground tomb. Dusty and exhausted, [character] attempts to impart the lesson of all this faded glory.

events.name: Art of War

options.text: He should study the leadership of great generals.
He should memorize combat drills and tactics.

events.text: Scrolls and maps litter the palace floors, as [character] studies to advance his knowledge of military tactics. His tutor, [character], wants to know what direction he should take in shaping the young tactician's mind. The art of war takes a lifetime to master, and lessons learned now will lay the foundation for the kind of leader [character] becomes.

events.name: Bystander

options.text: Attack the boys and drive them away.
Distract the boys with a humorous story.
Wait until it's safe and nurse the cat back to health.
Do nothing. Urchins will always chase cats.

events.text: One day during lessons with his tutor, [character] hears a clamor beyond the palace walls. A group of urchins chase a terrified cat along the street, laughing and striking it with sticks. [character] notices his pupil's interest and challenges him to intervene. What does the royal tutor advise?

events.name: Combat Training

options.text: Attacking your opponent relentlessly until he submits.
Carefully picking apart your opponent's weaknesses.

events.text: Young and impetuous, [character] is constantly fighting and wrestling with the children of the palace servants. It is time for him to harness all that extra energy and direct it toward productive ends. [character] will train him in the art of combat. What style of fighting should he emphasize?

events.name: Day in Court

options.text: Observing the dynamics of families and power.
Establishing a personal relationship with the heir.
Watching courtiers debate and compromise.

events.text: Debate is a key skill for any young royal. To further improve [character]'s skill with political leaders, [character] brings him to court. It is a busy day with speeches by all in attendance, including the heir, [character]. How should he spend this time in the halls of power?

events.name: Hands Dirty

options.text: Sowing seeds and growing plants.
Identifying rocks and minerals.
Managing trees and forests.

events.text: [character] and [character] spend a dirty day in the nearby fields, digging up stones, examining soil, and sketching plants. The young student seems to have a natural affinity for agriculture. What shall [character] emphasize in his lessons?

While [character] believes that learning to fight without armor is the best way to foster bravery, [character] insists that fighting with armor better prepares one for military duties and battlefield tactics. They turn to you for advice on how to proceed.

options.text: To haggle with merchants to bring prices down.
To search carefully for the very lowest prices.

options.text: Either the deal meets all my demands, or I walk away.
I will compromise for the sake of good relations.

events.name: An Admirer

options.text: Well, don't you look delectable.
Ah, you must be the entertainment.

events.text: You knew that your soirees had been gaining a certain... reputation in [rival]. But the abrupt arrival one night of the [tribe] entourage, headed by a grinning [character], still comes as something of a shock.

events.name: A Fine Roast

options.text: Oh, no, I didn't mean it like that [character]! It's the height of flattery! Oh, sorry...

events.text: You cannot remember a finer evening. The food, the wine, the company... the delicious look on that bastard [character] face when you started joking about his height! Who knew he was so sensitive...

events.name: Bleak Light of Day

options.text: You will teach me to master my will, my prohairesis, [character].
I know, deep down, you are correct. No matter how we struggle, the world will do as it wishes, and we may only watch.
... I would say it is too early for this, but, honestly, refrain from spouting drivel at any hour.

events.text: As you nurse headaches both literal and metaphorical, it slowly dawns on you that someone has been speaking to you for some time. Your eyes flick to [character] steward, [character], currently expounding in a calm, steady voice- did you speak more than you intended last night? The topic feels... uncomfortably personal. "...it is as true for you, my king, as it is for I, a humble slave; that beyond our own wills, our prohairesis, nothing in this world is truly in our control. All that we struggle and strain against is naught but illusion. Accepting that we control only our thoughts, and mastering those, is the only path that can possibly avoid a life of waste and pain."

events.name: Enough

options.text: Meet his gaze.
[character] deserves a better life.

events.text: There is an entire taxonomy of the stares bestowed by [character], you have found. The concern. The loneliness. The disgust. The quiet despair.

events.name: A Little Advice

options.text: Alright, alright, fine.
I'm not going to pee on a bundle of barley, [character].

events.text: It took patience, experimentation, and the help of a good number of practiced individuals, but you got there in the end. An evening of such exquisite sensual perfection that the troubles of everyday life seem suddenly to belong to another person.... you do, perhaps, have some tiny regrets about inviting [character], though. She means well, she really does. "Darling, you really better check though, you never know when the heavens will a new child. Just a few minutes and a sheaf of barley, and then you can stop wondering about it."

events.name: Ante Depressant

options.text: Fortunately [character] has always been gracious about beginners' losses.
The [title] does not require gracious indulgence.

events.text: Drinking, dancing, exotic delights and beauties from far off lands, you try it all. In the end, however, it is only at [character] table with the dice rolling that you feel truly alive and at peace with yourself.

events.name: Epiphany

options.text: Rulership will destroy me if I let it.
I suppose the trick is just to not think about it.

events.text: Shouting over the raucous banter, you had felt free, in the moment, even joyous, as you called out 'what if I was just NOT king anymore?' The room paused. Eyes were averted. Later, [character] would say quietly it was just the wine talking. But the thought lingers.

guaranteed.text: Steam achievement: Behind The Throne Whats The Worst That Happens

events.name: I Did What Now?

options.text: Uh, of course I did. Let [rival] quake before our righteous armies!
That's not- that can't... there has a been a misunderstanding.

events.text: You declared war on [rival]. Everyone agrees, last night during the party you absolutely insisted the messenger depart at once to inform the [rival] of their inferiority and impending defeat.

events.name: If Stairs Could Kill

options.text: Scream.
Contemplate the agony in silence.

events.text: The morning after, you remember little, and awaken in a tangle of limbs. Not an unusual occurrence in recent days. This tangle, however, is somewhat different in nature. Such awakenings rarely occur at the foot of stairways, and, more to the point, usually consist of some tangled limbs other than your own.

events.name: Is This All There Is to Life?

options.text: And yet, the sheer distraction becomes more essential by the day.

events.text: Each evening of supposed delights seems to blur into the next.

events.name: Living in the Moment

options.text: Just don't think about the future.

events.text: It's easy, once you see clearly.

events.name: Trendsetter

options.text: It's good to be [title].
Flattering. But this could get expensive, fast.

events.text: You rather have a knack for this, you think. Nobles across [rival] are hosting imitations of your exclusive parties and aping your every nuance of fashion.

events.name: Schemes Exposed

options.text: I suppose all that matters now is victory.

events.text: Your attempts to oust [character] may not have been as subtle as you had hoped. The very night you expected to hear word of his sad, yet untraceable, demise... you instead hear the sound of armed clashes through the streets of [city]. [rival] is at war with itself. Did your attempt on [character] life simply accelerate his treasonous schemes... or did you create the Civil War by forcing his hand?

events.name: Unsafe

options.text: Sleep poorly.

events.text: Nothing. You have found nothing, heard nothing, and [character] carries merrily on as if all is exactly as it should be.

events.name: [rival] Interference

options.text: I suppose [character] means to provoke a war. He has.
Not the price I wished to pay, but at least [rival] is at last rid of our dear [character].

events.text: Plans were made. Informants found. Deals crafted. Dates set. And yet, in the end, it was all for naught. [character] rode to [city] just days ago, where he used his popularity and connections to invite [rival] forces inside the city itself. [character] was then most pleased to announce [character], and [city], under the protection of the [rival] crown.

events.name: Accused

options.text: There is nothing for it, I suppose. Leave them to their whispers.
Enough. A nest of vipers I can handle, or a court of the feebleminded. But Gods help any King when those are one and the same.

events.text: Threatening [rival] future is not enough, it seems. Now [character] has taken to tearing up its past, digging up ancient rumors and falsehoods about the revered [character]. The worst of it, of course, is that much of the court believes it, that you are in fact but the illegitimate bastard of [character], having usurped the throne in a malignant plot. And what proof can be offered in the face of such groundless slander? Each retort is only yet more proof of deep conspiracy.

events.name: Tables Turn

options.text: And somehow, none of that tells you when the knives will come out.

events.text: A misplaced word or a turncoat. Someone has let slip to [character] your plans. You know this, of course, through your own turncoat. So, now you dance. You know that he knows that you know that he knows, and so on, past the point of madness.

options.text: Perhaps it is time to trust the old ways.
I'll... think about it.

events.text: [character] listens with sympathy to your political troubles, but opines that, sadly, his faith does not have the sway in [rival] it once did. But he assures you, "While I cannot help you, trust in the gods can. You need only seek their blessing."

events.name: A Capable Hand

options.text: Grant [character] full authority over administration.
Politely decline the assistance.

events.text: [character] assures you, there is one man who understands the politics of [rival] better than any other. [character] has been a close advisor to [character] for quite some time, and he swears there is no problem [character] cannot solve if given the power and resources.

events.name: An Advance on a Retreat

options.text: As it so happens, I know just the spot to develop!
Nod wistfully.

events.text: [character] has dropped numerous hints about how lovely it would be to enjoy a summer retreat in the countryside of [city], if only there were a suitable place to host a relaxed meeting of the notables of [rival].

events.name: A Man Without a Past

options.text: I will take what allies I can.
Such confidence is not always a positive sign.

events.text: Not a man of great public acclaim and standing, no. But [character] claims he can solve your problems, and a great many more besides.

options.text: Laugh it off as a joke.
Roll the dice.

events.text: [character] stare can only be described as impassive. Is this a joke? A bluff? His proposed ante is "the orphan eater", with your own wager being your general [character].

events.name: Fortune Favors

options.text: Water under the bridge, [character].
Not to worry, [character]. I can offer ample opportunities to settle the score.

events.text: It is said that fortune favors the bold, and perhaps that is what [character] had in mind, staking all he had and more at the dice table. Bold or not though, on this occasion, fortune seemed more inclined to spit in [character] drink and kick his shins. The debts he now owes to you, personally, are of truly ludicrous proportions.

events.name: Payout

options.text: Luck never holds, in the long run. There is no better time to stop.
Nothing can stop me, now that I'm on a roll.

events.text: This is it. The perfect night, the perfect streak of decisions and luck. Near enough every coin in the house making its way to your side of the table.

events.name: Setting an Example

options.text: This kind of idleness in the people is unacceptable. Conscript every able bodied [rival] you can find in the gambling halls.
Perhaps the laws among the common folk should be relaxed. It is only fair.
A lack of enforcement has benefits.

events.text: It has become an open secret that the [title] has a keen interest in games of chance, and around the capitol, business in the still-illegal vice is surging.

events.name: Under the Table

options.text: If that's not a message from the fates, I don't know what is.

events.text: They are gone. It's impossible, of course. They had only rolled under the table. But after moving every piece of furniture, rearranging every item, checking every pocket, the Bone Dice are nowhere to be found.
